expires_today.title: The Tanith Lee Collection by DAW Books
expires_today.long_description: Discover the unforgettable tales of one of science fiction and fantasy’s greatest authors in this bundle of Tanith Lee ebooks from DAW! Meet a Martian vampire desperate to evade the prying eyes of a private detective in Sabella. Follow people living on the dark side of a planet that might be about to contact another civilization in Day by Night. Explore the mysteries of a medieval-inspired world with a reluctant goddess in The Birthgrave. There are 26 books in total in this bundle from the master fantasist, so grab them all now at the price of your choice, and support BINC with your purchase!

expires_today.title: LIFETIME ACCESS CREATOR
expires_today.long_description: Unlock a universe of professional sound effects—and keep it forever with the Lifetime Access Creator Bundle by Noise Alchemy! Perfect for game developers, film composers, content creators, and sound designers, this comprehensive SFX library offers 120+ handcrafted audio assets. Choose from three unique tiers that offer the perfect fit for any budget. Tier 1 gives you instant access to the bundle for 24 hours, Tier 2 gives you a full 30 days to explore the entire platform, and Tier 3 unlocks everything—for life. We’re talking permanent, unlimited access to the entire platform! Pay what you want for raw, flexible materials ready to be transformed into your next great audio project and help support Music Will with your purchase.

expires_tomorrow.title: The Complete Claude AI for Blender Bundle
expires_tomorrow.description: Clear your calendar with Claude AI
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
Save development time, money, and sweat equity with The Complete Claude AI for Blender Bundle. Design unique characters, dynamic environments, and more with this curated 15+ course library. Led by AI Box Modeling with Blender in Claude Code and Digital Sculpting Basics with Blender in Claude Code, this bundle has everything you need to implement Claude AI into fundamental development processes with minimal friction. Reduce your development cycle with leading AI tools today, and help support Girls Who Code with your purchase!

expires_tomorrow.title: Linux: All the Things by O'Reilly
expires_tomorrow.long_description: Tired of that stale operating system? Add color, customization, and optimization to your workstation with the all-new Linux: All the Things Bundle by O'Reilly! Master the fundamentals of Linux with 15 eBooks that cover everything you need to know. Pay what you want for an expertly curated Linux library designed to streamline your learning journey with foundational eBooks like Learning Git, Linux Pocket Guide, and Practical Linux System Administration. Unlock what’s possible with Linux, and help support Code for America with your purchase!

expires_tomorrow.title: Craft Your Cosplay Dreams
expires_tomorrow.long_description: With this bundle of how-to books on crafting the perfect cosplay, you have everything you need to turn yourself into the main character! Or the charming sidekick. Or the character nobody understands better than you. Try your hand at blacksmithing without all the fuss and craft the swords, shields, and armor of your wildest imagination. Collect patterns for masks, ears, pouches, and witch hats. Learn the ins and outs of 3D printing, cosplay as a business, and how to give your photos the aura they deserve. There’s a lot more included in the pages of this bundle, so get it now at the price of your choice, and choose your own charity to support with your purchase!

expires_tomorrow.description: Create a slice of American life
expires_tomorrow.long_description:

expires_tomorrow.title: Creature and Character Creation Bundle
expires_tomorrow.long_description:

expires_within_72h.title: Learn to Make Games in Unity 2026 Bundle
expires_within_72h.description: Learn to make games with Unity
expires_within_72h.long_description:
Take your first steps into game development with one of the world’s most popular game engines, Unity. Whether you’re completely new to coding and game creation or ready to build bigger and more advanced projects, this bundle gives you the tools to grow your skills through hands-on learning. Start with beginner-friendly courses like Create Your First 2D Game in Unity and Create Your First 3D Game in Unity, then continue into larger projects like Complete Action RPG, Farming RPG, Tower Defense, and Construct a First Person Shooter. Along the way, you’ll learn C# programming, game systems, debugging, optimization, multiplayer, VR, and more. Pay what you want for a complete Unity learning bundle that can help turn your passion for games into real development skills and help support Alzheimer's Research UK with your purchase.
